support_scope.local_completion: The evidence bundle schema, fixture, and documentation are present and validated.
support_scope.external_gate: not applicable, but RC/GA release promotion is blocked until gap_blockers are closed in concrete release artifacts.
support_scope.runtime_support_claim: No release-candidate, GA, package, stream, or calculator support claim is made by this bundle format alone.

completion_policy: complete-with-gaps means the release evidence bundle schema and fixture exist, but no RC or GA release claim is allowed unless required evidence is present and gap_blockers are closed

gap_blockers.description: Release bundles must include registry evidence so recipe-only, private, future-only, unpublished, and published-with-gaps states cannot be mistaken for public publication evidence.
Release automation must reject RC or GA claims when required bundle evidence is missing or marked with unresolved limitations.

promotion_requirements: Require registry evidence in every release evidence bundle.
Attach evidence bundles to release artifacts before RC or GA support claims.
Reject GA promotion when required evidence is missing or gap statuses remain unresolved.
description: Define the release evidence bundle required before release-candidate or GA support claims.
